title: Project
description: Full Project representation (BE-02). This is the stored/response shape, not a POST /api/v1/projects create-only body. Audit fields are filled by JPA Auditing from the JWT principal (STD-23, STD-24); they are optional so create requests are not required to send them.

id.description: UUID identifier (ADR-005, STD-35). Server-generated on create.

name.description: Project name. Required (T-12). maxLength 200 aligns with T-24 structural validator (PROJECT_NAME_MAX / MetadataProject.name).

description.description: Optional project description (T-12 Week 1 metadata outline).

createdAt.description: JSON/JPA property createdAt (T-12, AuditableEntity). Filled by @CreatedDate (STD-24). Not client-supplied on create.

updatedAt.description: JSON/JPA property updatedAt (T-12, AuditableEntity). Filled by @LastModifiedDate (STD-24). Not client-supplied on create.

createdBy.description: Username from SecurityContextHolder / JWT via AuditorAware (STD-23, BE-08). Not client-supplied on create.

lastModifiedBy.description: Username from AuditorAware on update (STD-23, STD-24). Not client-supplied on create.
